recap:
## Decisions
- Prototype: a rubber, curvy case that flips open on the side. The cover has the basic buttons, and an LCD with menu wheel sits inside. [00:02:37]
- Show the logo in grey, as on the website. [00:05:51]
- Add a locator dot that sticks on the TV. [00:12:09]
- Evaluation scores:
  - Attractive: 7 [00:09:46]
  - Locatable: 7 [00:12:23]
  - Intuitive: 5 [00:13:22]
  - Ergonomic: 6 [00:14:42]
  - Voice control: 7 [00:15:07]
  - Average about 6.5 [00:16:45]
- Remove the sample sensor to meet the €12.50 budget. [00:21:19]
- Replace the side scroll wheel with up/down volume pushbuttons. [00:23:53]
- Replace the sample speaker with a simple beeper, which keeps the locator. [00:25:05]
- Final cost is within budget, with about €1 to spare. [00:30:32]

## Action items
- PM: Send the costs to management and note that the team is unsure about the colour cost. [00:24:17]
- owner not assigned: Look into how well the remote works for left-handed users. [00:13:54]
- PM, ID, UI, ME: Complete the final questionnaire and meeting summary when they are sent. [00:32:14]

## Unresolved
- Left-handed use: UI suggested a mirror-image version, and PM noted that families mix left- and right-handers. [00:10:13]
- How mute will work now that the scroll wheel is gone. UI suggested an extra mute button, but the team didn't confirm it. [00:23:01]
- Whether the rubber case counts as a curved or flat surface for costing. [00:22:07]
- Whether "special colour" costs extra. [00:24:21]
- Whether the locator should beep or vibrate. [00:25:28]
